observations: Third-reader verified inventory. All 4 original screenshots, the 8 pre-rendered zooms and additional tight crops (prefix c in the zoom folder) were read. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, option, default value, enabled state and truncation flag; their differences were descriptive only (B alone recorded the size of 3.PNG and the RGB fill values, A hedged the G/C header glyph). One typing change was made against both readers: the Audit Trail Patient box has the light editable-field fill, so it is recorded as text_input with its SEARCH button as a separate button control (the convention already used in daily_reports.json and ledger_reports.json) instead of one picker - 31 controls instead of their 30. A pixel-cluster sweep of every screenshot (every pixel that is not one of the flat background colours, run with and without tolerance) found nothing beyond the items listed here: no tiny right-edge checkbox (no 'Page Break'), no extra greyed-out control, no instruction or legend text, no second list column, no scrollbar on either panel, no footer text. COVERAGE: 4 screenshots = 4 reports, each selected exactly once (blue radio dot located by pixel count): 1.PNG = Payment Plan Charges, 2.PNG = Uncollected Copay, 3.PNG = Audit Trail, 4.PNG = Time Clock Report, i.e. list order; every listed report has a screenshot. All four are the normal two-panel screen in its default state - no popup, no expanded dropdown, no scrolled second view, no foreign screen - so the Office / Office Group and User SELECT dialogs, the patient SEARCH dialog and the option lists of the Audit Type and Module Type dropdowns are NOT documented by this category. SCREEN CHROME (identical in all 4): dark title bar with 'Management Reports' at the left and 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon (icon only, no text) at the far right. Blue sub-header bar: 'SELECT REPORT' over the left panel, 'REPORT CRITERIA' over the right panel with the grey-styled CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) at its right end (the same grey styling as in the other categories, i.e. not a disabled state). A splitter / collapse grip (three dots in a dark notch) sits on the border between the two panels at mid height. The action bar at the bottom of the criteria panel holds the blue PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon) buttons, right-aligned. Below the panels there is only an empty grey strip; 2.PNG and 4.PNG show a full-width 1 px darker line in it (host-page chrome), no text. LEFT PANEL 'SELECT REPORT': a SINGLE column of exactly 4 radio rows separated by thin white lines (no second column in this category); the rest of the panel is uniform empty navy down to the window edge, so the list is NOT scrollable or clipped. NO TRUNCATION: in every screenshot the first section header is fully visible under the panel border and the last criteria row is followed by 161 to 207 px of uniform blank space down to the action bar. RECURRING PATTERNS: (1) OFFICE/GROUP on all 4 reports = radios Office (selected) / Office Group (enabled) plus an unlabelled read-only box '108' (the current office, same number as the OID in the title bar) with a blue SELECT button (building icon); it is full width on Payment Plan Charges and Uncollected Copay and the left half of a two-column block (beside USER) on Audit Trail and Time Clock Report. (2) USER (Audit Trail and Time Clock Report only) = row 'User' with a read-only box showing ALL and a blue SELECT button (person-plus icon), with an empty second row beneath it. (3) Dates: every date field shows 11/21/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY, the capture day, i.e. the default appears to be today) with a calendar icon inside the box; Payment Plan Charges has a single 'Billing Date' under REPORT DATE, the other three have Start Date / End Date under DATE RANGE. (4) PRINT FORMAT (PDF selected / Excel) exists only on Payment Plan Charges and Uncollected Copay; Audit Trail and Time Clock Report show no PRINT FORMAT section at all. (5) REPORT FORMAT exists only on Uncollected Copay (Detail / Summary) and Time Clock Report (Detail / Summary / Employee Total Only), Detail selected on both. (6) Report-specific options: Payment Plan Charges = PLAN TYPE Regular / Ortho plus the three checkboxes Ortho Patient / Ortho Primary / Ortho Secondary; Uncollected Copay = 'Patient Balance Greater Than' amount (0.00); Audit Trail = Patient lookup plus the Audit Type and Module Type dropdowns (both ALL); Time Clock Report = 'Group By Office' checkbox. ABSENT in this category: PROVIDER picker, PATIENT TYPE, TRANSACTION TYPES, GROUP BY and SORT BY sections, listboxes, Page Break checkboxes. DISABLED STATES (confirmed by pixel colour: greyed labels and checkbox borders are RGB 161 with a 209 box fill, enabled labels are black and enabled buttons blue 41,134,220): Ortho Patient, Ortho Primary and Ortho Secondary on Payment Plan Charges (captured with Plan Type = Regular) and Group By Office on Time Clock Report (captured with Office and the single office 108). What enables them is not shown; that Ortho enables the first three and that Office Group / several offices enables the last is an inference from the labels. Every other control - including every Office Group radio and every SELECT / SEARCH button - is enabled. VISUAL CONVENTION: read-only picker boxes (office 108, User ALL) are grey (220,223,226); editable fields - the date boxes, the balance box, the two dropdowns and the Audit Trail Patient box - are lighter (241,241,241). RENDERING CAVEAT: in the bold section-header font the capital G shows almost no crossbar at this resolution, so the headers look like 'OFFICE/CROUP' and 'DATE RANCE'; the pixel dump shows the G spur and the mixed-case labels 'Office Group' and 'Group By Office' show a clear G, so they are transcribed as OFFICE/GROUP and DATE RANGE. Layout seam: a 1 px line of panel background separates the REPORT DATE block from the PLAN TYPE header (1.PNG) and the DATE RANGE block from the PATIENT header (3.PNG); nothing is drawn in it. Screenshot sizes: 1366x590, 1366x591, 1364x586, 1366x590 px (3.PNG is shifted 2 px left; same content layout). No reading needed a '[?]' marker.

supplement_unresolved.question: What enables Ortho Patient / Ortho Primary / Ortho Secondary? "Enabled for Ortho" comes from our own capture; the meaning of the three checkboxes (patient-portion, primary-insurance, secondary-insurance periodic charges) and of Billing Date is inferred. No vendor source shows the PLAN TYPE = Ortho state of this report.

The effect of REPORT FORMAT Detail / Summary is inferred for Uncollected Copay. Vendor text says the report covers the patients on the schedule who have a patient balance due, which implies - but does not state - that Start Date / End Date select by appointment date; confirm on the live legacy screen.
Exact values of the Audit Type dropdown are unverified. Vendor text only lists the tracked actions: Edit, Delete, Close out, Reschedule Appointment, Cut/Copy - Paste Appointment.

Values of the Module Type dropdown other than ALL and Appointments are not documented, and the legacy order is unknown. Vendor text names the modules the Audit Trail tracks (Appointments, Patient, Setup, Transactions, Treatment Plan) and the sample output shows PATIENT / Patient, Transactions, Treatment Plan and Appointments in its Type column; that these are the dropdown values is presumed, not verified.
Contents of the User > SELECT dialog and of the Patient SEARCH dialog are not documented. That an empty Patient box means all patients comes from our own capture only.
Default of the Account / Patient radios in the patient-level `Audit Trail Report` dialog is not documented.

What enables `Group By Office` and what does it do? The document says disabled for a single office and infers grouping by office when several are selected; the vendor states that the office of a clock in / out is not tracked, yet the option exists.

Contents of the OFFICE/GROUP > SELECT dialog (and its Office Group variant) and of the User > SELECT dialog of Time Clock Report are not documented; the research document lists the contents of the SELECT / SEARCH dialogs as a gap.
